title: Low-current MOSFET drift-diffusion verification benchmark
description: An open, code-agnostic reference set for the zero-bias (linear-response) terminal conductances of two-dimensional n-channel MOSFETs at low current, with published meshes, a scorer, a failure-mode atlas of terminal-current evaluation (including DEVSIM 2.11.2's default contact current and AC analysis), a pre-registered analysis of why the coupled small-signal solve fails and of the grid convergence of the references, and a pre-registered AI-agent study. Code is MIT-licensed (LICENSE); data, documentation and text are CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA.md).
